name: cold-md
description: The full cold.md suite for Claude Code. Six skills that run your cold outreach end-to-end: ICP building, lead sourcing, drafting, sending, reply triage, and reporting. Backed by the FoxReach API for sending infrastructure. Reads the open cold.md spec.

FOXREACH_API_KEY.description: API key from foxreach.io/settings/api. Required for cold-leads, cold-send, cold-triage, cold-report. Get one free at https://foxreach.io/signup.
